editorial.blurb: Chef Nicolai's inventive tasting menu in a stunning new space orchestrates an unforgettable evening of creative, precisely executed dishes in an intimate communal setting.
editorial.insiderTip: This is a community table experience (up to 16 diners) — arrive ready to meet fellow food lovers, and know that the ever-changing tasting menu has no pre-set options, so mention any allergies upfront; the cocktail and wine pairings are phenomenal and worth the investment.
